proof_boundary: This proves a stable joined representation of the full-support outer modes, exact endpoint reassembly, physical P_lin pullthrough, h-scale terminal centering of the genuine-edge endpoint trace, and Hermitian/transpose decomposition of the four quadratic outer pairings. It proves no complete outer-complement bound, quadratic residual estimate, signed full-current or Phi_B theorem, contact exclusion, retained aggregate or Xi theorem, Q209, cofinal descendant theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.certificate: m_N=floor(alpha_P/(N+1/2))+1, n_N=floor(2alpha_P), and R_N={m_N,...,n_N}.
rows.claim: The reciprocal physical band is one finite integer roster.
rows.proof_boundary: The outer modes remain infinite.

rows.certificate: For x(u)=alpha_P/u, a_x=x-m_N+1>1/4 and b_x=n_N+1-x>alpha_P on 1<=u<=N.
rows.claim: Every possible stationary integer lies inside the band.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not an outer-sum bound.

rows.certificate: The complement uses the same half-open reciprocal band as the finite-cell theorem; at a moving integer tie its transfer must be joined to the band before differentiation.
rows.claim: Band/complement transfer uses the exact half-open convention.
rows.proof_boundary: The complement must not be differentiated alone at a tie.

rows.certificate: S_1^[N](x)=psi(b_x)-psi(a_x)=PV sum_(r notin R_N)1/(x-r).
rows.claim: Both outer tails have one stable joined first-order kernel.
rows.proof_boundary: It may grow logarithmically.

rows.certificate: S_2^[N](x)=zeta(2,a_x)+zeta(2,b_x)=sum_(r notin R_N)1/(x-r)^2.
rows.claim: The second-order outer kernel is an absolute Hurwitz sum.
rows.proof_boundary: This does not bound physical coefficients.

rows.certificate: S_3^[N](x)=zeta(3,a_x)-zeta(3,b_x)=sum_(r notin R_N)1/(x-r)^3.
rows.claim: The third-order outer kernel retains the tail orientation.
rows.proof_boundary: Its sign alone does not sign the flow.

rows.certificate: At integer x in R_N, S_1^[N](x)=H_(n_N-x)-H_(x-m_N); no cotangent pole is separated.
rows.claim: Integral stationary crossings have a finite harmonic value.
rows.proof_boundary: Separating cotangent poles is forbidden.

rows.certificate: On the physical segment S_2^[N]<21, |S_3^[N]|<73, and Z_4^[N]<278. These bound kernels, not the complete outer functional.
rows.claim: All absolute denominator kernels needed after two integrations are uniformly bounded.
rows.proof_boundary: No complete outer-complement estimate follows.

rows.certificate: I_P(r)=kappa[e(phi_r)A_P/q_r]_1^N-kappa^2[e(phi_r)(D_rA_P)/q_r]_1^N+kappa^2 integral_1^N e(phi_r)C_rA_P du.
rows.claim: Every outer Fourier mode has an exact twofold nonstationary representation.
rows.proof_boundary: Endpoint terms remain main terms.

rows.claim: The twice-integrated interior operator is explicit.
rows.proof_boundary: Its physical aggregate is not evaluated.

rows.certificate: B_mu^[N][P]=e(alpha_Plog mu){kappa A_P(mu)S_1^[N](alpha_P/mu)-kappa^2[A_P'(mu)S_2^[N](alpha_P/mu)+(alpha_P/mu^2)A_P(mu)S_3^[N](alpha_P/mu)]}.
rows.claim: Each physical endpoint is represented by one joined three-kernel functional.
rows.proof_boundary: The N endpoint must remain joined to the edge row.

rows.certificate: O_N[P]=B_N^[N][P]-B_1^[N][P]+kappa^2 sum_(r notin R_N)^sym integral_1^N e(phi_r)C_rA_P du.
rows.claim: The complete lower and upper complements reassemble before absolute values.
rows.proof_boundary: No scalar smallness is asserted.

rows.certificate: Only S_1 is principal-value conditional; the S_2, S_3, and interior C_r terms are absolutely summable after the joined twofold integration by parts.
rows.claim: Only the first endpoint kernel is conditionally convergent.
rows.proof_boundary: Its symmetric convention is structural.

rows.certificate: The complete outer linear correction is Re[nu c_xi O_N[P_lin^[N]]], with no six-moment componentwise split.
rows.claim: The full outer linear correction remains one physical polynomial functional.
rows.proof_boundary: The functional is not yet bounded.

rows.certificate: P_lin^[N](log N)=F_(alpha_N)(log N)-i u_N F_(beta_N)(log N).
rows.claim: The terminal P_lin value separates its frequency and base rows exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: The alpha row need not vanish.

rows.certificate: For beta_E=(mathcal N_E,V_E,-Q_E,-A_E), P_E(lambda)=i(lambda-log a)F_(beta_E)(lambda).
rows.claim: The genuine endpoint enters only through the lifted beta row.
rows.proof_boundary: The edge is not assigned to a scalar cell.

rows.certificate: B_N^[N][P_E] has exact factor i exp(S(log N)) times {-kappa u_NF S_1-kappa^2 N^(-1)[F-u_N(F'+gF)]S_2+kappa^2 alpha_Pu_NN^(-2)F S_3}.
rows.claim: The N-endpoint edge trace is one pole-free exact expression.
rows.proof_boundary: No coefficient norm is inserted.

rows.certificate: The conditional S_1 edge coefficient has the exact factor u_N<2h; the remaining edge coefficients contain either N^(-1)<=(3/2)h or alpha_Pu_N/N^2<9h/2.
rows.claim: Every edge-only terminal multiplier carries h-scale suppression.
rows.proof_boundary: The surviving physical rows may still be large.

rows.certificate: The F_(alpha_N)(log N) coefficient survives without u_N. Thus terminal centering suppresses the edge-only trace but does not algebraically cancel the complete lower-boundary package.
rows.claim: The terminal strip does not generically annihilate the complete lower-boundary trace.
rows.proof_boundary: A source-specific signed estimate is still required.

rows.certificate: R_out=(1/2)Re[|nu|^2 H_out+nu^2 c_xi^2 T_out], where H_out uses O_X conjugate(O_dotY) and T_out uses O_X O_dotY with signs +,+,-,-.
rows.claim: The four outer observation pairings split exactly into Hermitian and transpose channels.
rows.proof_boundary: Neither channel is signed here.

rows.certificate: The common phase cancels exactly from H_out and appears squared in T_out.
rows.claim: The common auxiliary phase behaves correctly in both quadratic channels.
rows.proof_boundary: Imaginary coefficients remain.

rows.certificate: The retained moving-tail defect remains 2Delta(omega_C)^TJdot(omega_B)+2(omega_E+omega_B+omega_C)^TJdot(omega_C); it is not an outer-mode remainder and is added exactly once.
rows.claim: The moved terminal block remains a retained observation package.
rows.proof_boundary: It must not be counted as an outer residual.

rows.certificate: Estimate it jointly with the reciprocal-band carrier, Hermitian, transpose, correction, and moved-tail kernels before any modulus.
rows.claim: The only unsuppressed conditional boundary coefficient is the complete physical alpha-row trace.
rows.proof_boundary: The edge recurrence alone cannot close the sign.

rows.certificate: Insert O_N[P_lin^[N]], H_out, T_out, and the moved-tail defect into tilde(Psi)' and establish the direct negative retained-current target.
rows.claim: Prove or falsify the joined full-support kernel at the h^2 flow scale.
rows.proof_boundary: No such estimate is proved here.

rows.certificate: e(x)=exp(2pi i x), kappa=1/(2pi i), and the cotangent audit is the symmetric integer partial fraction; no plotted geometry is used.
rows.claim: All pi factors come from the fixed Fourier and completed-zeta conventions.
rows.proof_boundary: No geometric inference is made.

rows.certificate: The S2, S3, and Z4 bounds control denominators only; physical coefficient and signed correlation bounds remain open.
rows.claim: Kernel bounds are not promoted to a signed current theorem.
rows.proof_boundary: No Phi_B or retained-current sign follows.

rows.certificate: No complete outer bound, quadratic residual bound, signed flow, contact exclusion, Xi theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion is claimed.
rows.claim: This gate is an exact endpoint-kernel reduction, not a proof of RH.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not a proof of RH.
